question: Ano ang requirements at magkano ang bayad kada linear meter para kumuha ng Fencing Permit sa OCBO?
answer:
Sa pagpapakita ng Fencing Permit sa Office ng City Building Official (OCBO), ang mga requirements at ang bayad kada linear meter ay nakasaad sa [S1].

Ang mga requirements ay:
1. Fence Permit form with 3 sets of Civil/Architectural Plans ng fence

Ang bayad kada linear meter ay:
- Sa mga fence na may 1.80 meters o katig na lamang, ang bayad ay Php 3.00 per linear meter.
- Sa mga fence na may lamang 1.80 meters o higit pa, ang bayad ay Php 4.00 per linear meter.

ground_truth: A Fencing Permit is required prior to constructing a fence. Requirements include: 1) Fencing Permit form with 3 sets of Civil/Architectural plans signed and sealed by a licensed Civil Engineer/Architect; 2) Certified True Copy of Land Title (LRA/CASSO) and Tax Declaration; 3) Barangay Clearance; 4) Lot/Vicinity plan; and 5) Bill of Materials and Cost Estimates. The fee schedule under PD 1096 IRR is: PHP 3.00 per linear meter for fences made of masonry, metal, or concrete up to 1.80 meters in height; PHP 4.00 per linear meter for heights exceeding 1.80 meters; and PHP 2.40 per linear meter for fences made of indigenous materials, barbed, or hog wire.
